mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and, consequently, positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies invest in productivity-enhancing technologies.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM growth exceeds 5% and SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM decline exceeds 1% and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month and SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM growth exceeds 1% and UNRATE is below 5%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: the level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects the health of the labor market, with higher levels indicating a stronger economy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS levels are high but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% QoQ and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ growth exceeds 2% and FEDFUNDS is below 1%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
